citation.authors: Osman H, Usta IM, Rubeiz N et al

record.population: 210 first-time pregnant women in Lebanon, 175 completed
record.design: Multicentre, double-blind, randomised placebo-controlled trial of cocoa butter lotion until delivery
record.finding: Stretch marks developed in 45.1% with cocoa butter and 48.8% with placebo (P=0.730), with no difference in severity.
record.note: Not in women of African descent as far as the abstract shows.
